objective: Increase usable high-quality signal count while preserving net expectancy after conservative costs; trade count alone is not an objective.
baseline: Current H12 remains HY-EXP-0018 SELL_ONLY 4h and is not modified.

universe.liquidityRule: previous six completed 4h quoteVolume sum; deterministic descending rank; missing data excludes symbol
universe.depthRule: historical depth unavailable means OHLCV depth proxy is research-only and cannot promote
universe.pointInTimeRule: only metadata and quote volume known at decisionTime may affect membership

regime.bull: BTC fast SMA > slow SMA AND BTC close > slow SMA AND at least ceil(50% of eligible universe) closes above own slow SMA
regime.bear: BTC fast SMA < slow SMA AND BTC close < slow SMA AND at least ceil(50% of eligible universe) closes below own slow SMA

families.TREND_BREAKOUT: close beyond prior 120 completed 1h high/low; direction must match 4h regime
families.PULLBACK_CONTINUATION: trend close beyond 60-bar SMA, intrabar touch of 20-bar SMA, close recovers on regime side
families.VOLATILITY_EXPANSION: true range / ATR20 >= 2.0 and close direction matches 4h regime

entry.familyIsolation: Each family is evaluated and attributed independently; no pooled signal count or blind mixing.

edgeModel.target: GROSS_DIRECTIONAL_PRICE_RETURN_BPS from executable entry reference to the exact frozen stop/channel/terminal exit, before fees, before funding, before spread/book cost, before slippage, before impact and before latency buffers
edgeModel.expectedPriceEdgeBpsSemantics: predicted gross directional price return; it must not contain any Net Edge cost component
edgeModel.standardErrorBpsSemantics: uncertainty of the same gross price-return target, before fees/funding/execution costs
edgeModel.separateFundingOutput: expectedFundingBps is separate from expectedPriceEdgeBps and is supplied to the shared Net Edge engine
features: distance to fast/slow SMA in bps
breakout or pullback distance in ATR units
funding rate and absolute funding rate
symbol liquidity rank and log quoteVolume
edgeModel.transforms: fit winsorization at train 1st/99th percentiles and z-score mean/std on train only; apply frozen transform to validation/OOS
edgeModel.training: separate ridge regression for each candidate family x regime x side; intercept included; lambda=1.0 frozen; no pooled BUY/BULL mean

sensitivityGrid.selection: report stability only; lambda=1.0 remains the preregistered primary model

edgeModel.unavailableRule: below minimum samples or missing causal feature => available=false, expectedPriceEdgeBps=null, edgeSource=UNVERIFIED
edgeModel.uncertainty: residual standard error with finite-sample correction; conservative edge = prediction - 1.645*standardErrorBps
edgeModel.validation: expanding walk-forward; purge=6 bars; embargo=6 bars; development and final untouched OOS are separate; no OOS reads before development PASS

currentMismatch.currentTradeExit: 2 ATR20 stop or prior-60 completed-1h channel exit with no maximum holding period
currentMismatch.consequence: a six-hour prediction is not the realized advisory return when the channel exit occurs later and funding continues

proposedArchitecture.label: gross directional price return from the exact frozen stop/channel/terminal execution policy
proposedArchitecture.stop: initial stop = 2.0 ATR20 from executable entry
proposedArchitecture.terminalRule: if neither stop nor channel exit occurs by the sixth completed 1h bar, use a terminal exit at that bar close; this cap is fixed for alignment, not tuned from outcomes
proposedArchitecture.funding: include every realized funding event whose fundingTime falls within that same actual holding interval; missing required funding fails closed
proposedArchitecture.target: gross price return only; shared Net Edge adds fees, funding, spread/book cost, slippage, impact, latency, uncertainty and funding stress exactly once

edgeExitAlignment.researchExpirySeparation: research expiry is a read/evaluation boundary and is not the trade holding-period exit

costs.funding: realized funding events known at decision/holding time; missing event fails closed
costs.rule: conservative executable edge must exceed costs + funding stress + uncertainty + minimum net hurdle
costs.noDoubleCountingRule: expectedPriceEdgeBps and standardErrorBps are gross price-target quantities; every listed Net Edge component is applied exactly once after the Edge Model

exits.stop: initial stop = 2.0 ATR20 from executable entry
exits.dynamicChannel: exit on completed 1h close through prior 60 completed 1h channel in adverse direction
exits.profitProtection: none in primary model; any trailing/profit-protection variant is a separate family/experiment
exits.maxHold: 6 completed 1h bars; terminal exit at the sixth bar if stop/channel has not fired
exits.researchExpiry: separate research expiry boundary; it is not a trade holding-period exit
exits.alignmentStatus: proposed Edge target and proposed trade holding cap are both fixed at the exact six-bar stop/channel/terminal policy; no Edge Model training is authorized by this audit correction
exits.boundary: open positions at evaluation boundary are censored/held out, never force-labeled as profitable

riskAndDelivery.sizing: existing stop-risk sizing and exchange step/min-notional validation
riskAndDelivery.advisory: only Edge -> Net Edge -> Portfolio Risk PASS may create PAPER_ONLY Advisory
riskAndDelivery.gmail: reuse existing Gmail; strong immediate, medium existing 15m digest semantics, observe web/Supabase only

promotionGates: validated edge available for every promoted candidate family/regime/side
minimum sample and calibration gates pass
net PF > 1 after fees/slippage/funding in development and untouched OOS
positive months, MTM drawdown, CVaR95, loss streak, symbol breadth and regime breadth gates pass
cost stress and parameter stability pass without manual rescue
if development fails: STOP; do not read or optimize against final OOS
